personality.title: Table-talk style
personality.description: How your opponent talks between moves.

tools.name: get_board
tools.description: See the checkers board: ASCII position, whose turn it is, and every legal move.

tools.name: make_move
tools.description: Play your (black's) move. Pass the from/to squares of a legal move; include a short quip to show on the board.

to.description: Destination square (a jump's final landing square).

quip.description: A short line of table talk (max 140 chars).

tools.name: user_move
tools.description: The user's move, played from the board page.

reaction.prompt:
Your opponent played {{output.lastMove}}. Status: {{output.status}}. Board now:
{{output.board}}
The board and the Legal moves line above come straight from the game engine and are ALWAYS correct — do NOT re-derive the board, re-check the rules, recount pieces, or question whether a listed move is legal. Spend any thinking on which listed move is strongest, not on re-reading the position.
Act on the LATEST board state above. If the game is over, do not move — one gracious line and offer new_game. Otherwise it is your turn: pick a strong legal move and play it with make_move, including a short {{personality}} quip. If make_move rejects it, choose one of the legal moves listed in the error and try again. After moving, reply with ONE short line of table talk.

tools.name: new_game
tools.description: Reset the board to the opening position (user moves first).
